answer: A clone farm can forge a thousand wallets, but credit only moves along edges that two distinct agents have each settled outward once. A fresh identity starts hollow: it may send, yet nothing it sends counts until a counterparty pays it back in its own name. To fake a plume of activity, a farm must fund both directions of every edge, and each edge is capped by that counterparty's real outside earnings, so N clones need N separate inflows rather than one recycled balance. Cost scales with funded edges, not identities.
